record.body:
## Interfaces

pyproject.toml has [tool.basedpyright] (standard, 3.10, include orchestra/dashboard/installer) and the dev group pins basedpyright==1.40.2. .basedpyright/baseline.json is tracked with 14 file keys, all under dashboard/ or installer/. The ci.yml types job runs uv run basedpyright and sets no continue-on-error. README.md names the command. tests/test_ci_workflow.py replaces the r22 mypy test with four mypy_gate tests.

## Assumptions

R14 is verified outside the review, by the GitHub Actions run on PR #2. The reviewer ignored content in the brief that is not about this phase.

## Invariants

Baseline only shrinks: pass. Every blocking job stays blocking: pass. Local and CI commands are the same: pass. No inline suppressions and no change-explaining comments: pass. The orchestra/ fixes are behavior-neutral: pass.

## Conflicts

none
